name: StreetVoxer agent API
description: The documented window.debug surface of https://www.streetvoxer.net/. Load the page in a WebGPU browser and call these from page JavaScript; window.debug.api.list() is the live, complete list. Agents with NO browser can still hand a user a game: see scenarioLinks, or call the MCP server (see mcp).
generatedBy: tools/make-agent-manifest.mjs from src/agentApi.js — do not edit by hand

mcp.transport: Streamable HTTP, stateless: POST one JSON-RPC 2.0 message per request. No auth.
mcp.local: node mcp/stdio.mjs from the source repository (stdio transport, same tools).

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: Whether StreetVoxer has OpenStreetMap data (buildings, roads, water, trees) at a coordinate, and from which regional archive. Terrain is worldwide either way. Call this before sending a user somewhere unfamiliar: an uncovered point opens as bare terrain.

tools.name: make_spawn_link
tools.description: A URL that opens StreetVoxer at a coordinate, on foot by default. Give it to the user to open in a desktop browser with WebGPU (current Chrome or Edge).

tools.name: make_scenario_link
tools.description: A URL that opens StreetVoxer at a coordinate and starts a quest there once the world has loaded. The quest is checked by the same validator the game runs, so a link this returns is one the game accepts; a refusal says what to change. Optional preload warms the area first (it moves the camera for a few minutes).

tools.name: read_scenario_link
tools.description: Decode a StreetVoxer URL: where it opens, the quest and preload it carries, and whether the game would accept them. Use it to check a link someone else wrote.

scenarioLinks.format: <spawn URL>#scenario=<encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({v:1, quest:<defineQuest spec>, preload?:{radiusMeters, lat?, lon?}}))>  or  #scenario=b64.<base64url of the same JSON>
rules: The quest is a defineQuest spec (see the defineQuest entry below) and is validated by the same checks when the link is opened; a refusal is shown to the player with its reason.
scope must be "once" (nobody hands a linked quest over).
It starts after the player spawns at the link's pose; the fragment never reaches the server.
Keep links under ~2000 characters; chat apps truncate long URLs.

Optional preload: generates and saves the area (radiusMeters at most 1500, centre lat/lon within 5 km of the spawn, default the spawn) after spawn and BEFORE the quest starts, so the quest plays over a warm region. It takes the camera for minutes (about 2-5 per km box) and the player can cancel it. With preload, quest may be omitted.

functions.doc: CONVENTIONS: angles in this API are compass angles in degrees, clockwise, north = 0 (bearingDeg, yawOffsetDeg; positive yaw turns the character right). Distances are metres, speeds m/s, money is cents, health/hunger/hydration are 0..1 fractions. Screen points are normalized canvas coordinates 0..1 with 0,0 at top-left.
searchLocation(query) -> Promise<{title, lat, lon}> — geocode a place name (Wikipedia geosearch) and fly there.

waitForSpawn(timeoutMs?) -> Promise<{ready, durationMs, sinceLoadMs}> — resolves when the player is controllable, before the camera settles. Compare timings across runs on sinceLoadMs; durationMs counts from the call.

waitForSpawnSettled(timeoutMs?) -> Promise<{ready, durationMs, sinceLoadMs, settledSinceLoadMs, settledMs, mode, cameraElevMeters, cameraPitchDeg, workerErrors}> — resolves after the spawn camera has settled.

spawnAt({lat, lon, ctrl?, elevMeters?|elev?, pitchDeg?|pitch?, bearingDeg?|bear?}, timeoutMs?) -> Promise<settled> — spawn anywhere without a reload; ctrl 0 free camera, 1 character, 2 vehicle. Pass a bearing for repeatable runs; omitting it keeps the approach heading.
waitForLocationSearchSpawn(query, timeoutMs?) -> Promise<{search, spawn, totalMs}> — searchLocation plus waitForSpawn in one call.

waitForChunksReady(timeoutMs?) -> Promise<{ready, totalChunks, marginExcluded, firstReadyMs, alreadyReadyAtCall, durationMs, sinceLoadMs}> — resolves when the voxel world around the player is built. Use firstReadyMs for load time; alreadyReadyAtCall:true means this call measured nothing.
getChunksFirstReadyMs() -> number|null — when the voxel grid first became ready (ms since load), or null.
resetChunksReadyMark() -> "ok" — re-arm the first-ready mark before measuring a second load in the same page.
saveAllLoadedChunks() -> Promise<{dispatched, skipped, elapsedMs}> — persist the loaded world to the local cache.

preloadRegion({lat?, lon?, radiusMeters?=500} | {south, west, north, east}, {settleTimeoutMs?, maxTargets?, frameBudgetMs?=40, renderEveryN?=4}?) -> {ok, box, code?} — generate and save every chunk of a region wider than the loaded area, so later visits load from cache. Takes the camera and locks player input until done; camera moves are refused meanwhile. Runs worldgen-first (larger frame budget, frame drawn every renderEveryN), restored after. Holds a screen wake lock while running. Refused while spawning (code spawning) or piloting an aircraft (code aircraft). Poll getPreloadState() -> {active, stop, stops, targets, written, fromCache, noSurface, pending, wakeLock, result:{ok, summary, verify}}; cancelPreload() stops early.

setWakeLock(on=true) -> Promise<{status, holders, supported}> — keep the screen awake for an unattended run (setWakeLock(false) releases). status: held, released (page was hidden; re-requested when visible), unsupported, refused: <reason>, or off. Does not keep a hidden tab running.
getWakeLockState() -> {status, holders, supported} — the screen wake lock and who holds it (agent, preload).
setKeyDown(key, isDown) — hold or release a key. Keys are UPPERCASE single characters or space.
setKeyUp(key) — release one held key.
clearAgentInputs() — release all held keys.
walkCharacter(keys, ms?, opts?) -> Promise<{movedMeters, swimEntered, everPaused, workerErrorsDelta, startPos, endPos}> — hold keys for ms (WASD, space = jump, C = crouch). Character mode.
setCharacterSteerTargetGeo(lat, lon, elevMeters?) / clearCharacterSteer() — keep the character's body turned toward a point; lat=null clears.

walkCharacterToGeo({lat, lon, elevMeters?}, opts?) -> Promise<{reached, reason, distMeters, closestMeters, startDistMeters, elapsedMs}> — walk straight to a point (opts.arriveMeters, timeoutMs, stallMs). Always check reason: arrived | stalled | timeout | bad-target | no-character | not-on-foot. No obstacle avoidance; for a target inside a building use walkCharacterToPlace.
driveRoute(points, opts?) -> Promise<{legs, reachedAll, travelledMeters, residualMeters, elapsedMs}> — walk the character through ordered {lat, lon} waypoints.
setVehicleIntent({forward|throttle, steer, handBrake}) — on/off vehicle controls, like W/A/S/D. Use setVehicleIntentAnalog for smooth control.
spawnHelicopter() / enterHelicopter() / despawnHelicopter() — create, board or remove the helicopter. Helicopter mode needs one to exist first.

setHelicopterIntent({collective, cyclicPitch, cyclicRoll, pedal, autoHover} | null) -> intent — raw helicopter controls, overriding the player; null hands back control. collective 0 = hover, cyclicPitch +1 = nose down, cyclicRoll +1 = right, pedal +1 = yaw right. Prefer setHelicopterAttitude for scripted flight.

getHelicopterState() -> {exists, paused, inMode, positionWorld, directionWorld, mastUpWorld, rotationQuat, speedMps, altitudeAglMeters, groundClearanceMeters, collective, commanded:{...}, autoHover, agentControlled, liftTrimFraction} — helicopter state. Use groundClearanceMeters for ground contact; altitudeAglMeters is height above terrain, not above a rooftop.

hoverHelicopter({timeoutMs?, speedMps?, holdMs?}) -> Promise<{settled, speedMps, altitudeAglMeters, elapsedMs, reason}> — centre the controls, enable auto-hover and wait until stationary. Stopping from speed takes several seconds.
getHelicopterSpec() -> spec — the helicopter's parameters.

getHelicopterAttitude() -> {pitchDeg, rollDeg, headingDeg, levelnessDeg, upset, bodyVelocityMps{forward,right,up}, verticalSpeedMps, groundSpeedMps, speedMps, workerSpeedMps, courseDeg, altitudeAglMeters, groundClearanceMeters, assistRunning} — attitude and motion relative to local level. Negative bodyVelocityMps.forward is rearward flight.
setHelicopterAttitude({pitchDeg?, rollDeg?, headingDeg?, altitudeMeters?, verticalSpeedMps?, timeoutMs?}) -> {ok, target} — fly to and hold an attitude. Omitted axes are held at zero.

flyHelicopterVelocity({forwardMps?, rightMps?, altitudeMeters?, headingDeg?, maxAttitudeDeg?, timeoutMs?}) -> {ok, target} — fly at a velocity relative to the nose; negative forwardMps flies backwards.

awaitHelicopterSettled({speedTolMps?, attitudeTolDeg?, altitudeTolMeters?, holdMs?, timeoutMs?}) -> Promise<{settled, reason, live, elapsedMs}> — wait until the last command holds for holdMs. Resolves on timeout.
stopHelicopterAssist({release=true}?) -> {stopped, reason, at} — stop the flight assist and hand the controls back.
exitHelicopter() -> {ok, atAltitudeAglMeters, expectRagdoll, craftAtExit} — get out. In the air this is a bail-out and the character falls.

spawnPlane({ground?, altitudeAboveCameraMeters?, speedMps?}) / enterPlane() / despawnPlane() — create, board or remove the plane. By default it starts in the air at flying speed; {ground:true} starts it on its wheels.

setPlaneIntent({elevator, aileron, rudder, throttle, cruiseAssist, wheelBrake} | null) -> intent — raw plane controls, overriding the player; null hands back control. elevator +1 = nose down. Prefer setPlaneAttitude for scripted flight.

getPlaneState() -> {exists, paused, inMode, airspeedMps, alphaDeg, stallFraction, stalled, throttle, cruiseAssist, wheelsOnGround, onGround, rolling, stallSpeedMps, cruiseSpeedMps, ...} — plane state. Detect liftoff with onGround, not height.

getPlaneAttitude() -> {pitchDeg, rollDeg, headingDeg, flightPathDeg, courseDeg, sideslipDeg, noseVsTravelDeg, bodyVelocityMps, verticalSpeedMps, speedMps, airspeedMps, alphaDeg, stalled, wheelsOnGround, altitudeAglMeters} — attitude and motion. pitchDeg is where the nose points, flightPathDeg where the plane is going.

setPlaneAttitude({pitchDeg?, rollDeg?, headingDeg?, altitudeMeters?, verticalSpeedMps?, airspeedMps?, throttle?, rudder?, timeoutMs?}) -> {ok, target} — fly to and hold an attitude, heading, altitude or airspeed. Set throttle to fix engine power instead of holding airspeed.

awaitPlaneSettled({attitudeTolDeg?, altitudeTolMeters?, speedTolMps?, holdMs?, timeoutMs?}) -> Promise<{settled, reason, live, elapsedMs}> — wait until the last command holds for holdMs. Resolves on timeout.
stopPlaneAssist({release=true}?) -> {stopped, reason, at} — stop the flight assist and hand the controls back.
exitPlane() -> {ok, atAltitudeAglMeters, expectRagdoll, craftAtExit} — get out. In flight this is a bail-out.
setControlMode(modeName) — FreeCamera | Character | Vehicle | LockCamera. For helicopter or plane, spawn then enter it.
enterCharacterFromFreeCamera() -> bool — switch from free camera to the character, landing on the ground below. Follow with waitForSpawn().
waitForVehicleSpawn(timeoutMs?) -> Promise<{ready, durationMs}> — resolves when the vehicle is drivable.
getVehicleState() -> {exists, paused, positionWorld, directionWorld, lastTransformAgeMs}
getCharacterState() -> {exists, paused, positionWorld, lastTransformAgeMs} — also lat, lon, elevationMeters, groundElevationMeters, aglMeters, swimming, flying.

getPlayerState() -> {controlMode, characterExists, vehicleExists, helicopterExists, planeExists, characterPaused, vehiclePaused, helicopterPaused, planePaused, ragdollActive, isSprinting, spawnUnpausePending, spawnHandoffActive}

getWorldgenStats() -> {chunkMap:{total,byStep}, tilesByZoom:{<z>:{total,inLOD,byElevStep}}, buffers:{<id>:fraction}, workerBacklog:{<rpcType>:count}, tilePools:{...}} — world-generation progress counters.
getWorldgenReport() -> string — a text report of world-generation timing.
getWorldgenWaitPolicy() / setWorldgenWaitPolicy({enabled?, maxInflight?, l2Batch?, l2TargetMs?}) -> policy — world-generation throughput while loading.

listProjectionPhotos({osmId}) / loadProjectionPhoto({index}|{url}) / setProjector({lat,lon,elevMeters,bearingDeg,pitchDeg,rollDeg?,fovDeg?|focal35mm?,frontFacingOnly?,buildingOnly?:true|osmId|false}|{fromCamera}) / getProjector() / projectionBuildingOutline({osmId, heightMeters?, roofOutsetMeters?}) / projectGeoToPhoto(points) / solveProjector(pairs[{u,v,lat,lon,elevMeters}], {fit:[horizontal|position|orientation|fov], apply}) / setProjectorOverlay(on) -> photo projection onto a building. Judge alignment from projectionBuildingOutline, not from the projector's own viewpoint.
getWorldgenDwellStats() -> object; resetWorldgenDwellStats() -> "ok" — the data behind getWorldgenReport, and starting a new measurement window.
getWorldgenPressure() -> {underPressure, signals:{...}} — whether world generation is currently loaded.
getOpportunisticSkeletonStats() -> {queueDepth,cap,enqueued,drained,invalidated,evicted,dropped,drainErrors,txnInFlight} — background cache-save queue.
getTileEvictionStats() -> {...} — tile unload counters.
getDeferredTileWriteStats() -> {queueDepth,drained,flushedOnUnload,forceFlushed,drainErrors,txnInFlight} — deferred tile cache writes.
getOpportunisticLoadedSkeletonStats() -> {enqueued,enabled}
getMemoryStats() -> {mainHeap:{usedMB,totalMB,limitMB}, cpuBufferMirrorsMB, gpu:{buffersMB,texturesMB,totalMB}, workerWasm:{lastMB,peakMB}, sharedInnerShapeCacheMB, chunkUnload} — memory use.
getChunkUnloadStats() -> {finalizedTotal, releasedTotalMB, windowMs, windowChunks, windowReleasedMB, chunksPerSec, releasedMBPerSec} — recent chunk unload rate.
getTransientEffectStats() -> {live, pending, head, tail, capacity, spawned, completed, retired, droppedFull, rejectedNonFinite, shifts, peakLive, clockSeconds} — short-lived visual effects pool.

getEditMarkerStats() -> {enabled, pending, spawned, settled, timedOut, noRebuild, recent:[{outcome, chunks, nodeEdits, estimateMs, actualMs}]} — pending-edit markers; actualMs is the delay from edit to rebuilt geometry.

spawnTransientEffect({lat,lon,elevMeters} | {aboveCharacterMeters}, {sizeMeters, rgb, alpha, durationSeconds, pending, style:fade|pendingEdit|muzzleFlash|impact|explosion|dust|tireSmoke, orientation:billboard|ground|cube}) -> {ok, handle} — show a short-lived effect.
completeTransientEffect(handle, seconds?) -> bool — end a pending effect.
getEffectEmitterStats() -> {tireSmokeFrames, landingBursts, explosionBursts, lastTireSlip[], tireSmokeSurface} — tyre smoke, landing and explosion dust.

unstuckCharacter() -> Promise<{ok, reason, rung, groundMeters, demMeters, feetMeters, liftMeters, pressFeetMeters, parkedMeters?, parkWaitMs?, attempts[]}> — the Unstuck button: put the character back on the ground.
startTransientEmitter({aboveCharacterMeters}, {ratePerSecond, lifetimeSeconds, spreadMeters, sizeMeters, rgb, alpha, durationSeconds, style:dust|tireSmoke|fade}) -> {ok} — emit effects for a while.
getBufferPoolStats() -> {perBuffer:[...], osmRegion:{...}, worstFrac, smallestLargestGapMB, largestPlaceableMB} — GPU buffer usage.

voxelAt({lat, lon, elevMeters}) -> {ok, chunk, l1, l2, node, editable, refusal?, solid, l0Material, hasBrick, l1Material, l1Flags, dedupSlot, subVoxelSolid, surface} — read the voxel at a point; solid is the 0.1 m cell there.
voxelSurfaceAt({lat, lon}, opts?) -> {ok, elevMeters, voxel} — the top solid surface at a location (opts.fromElevMeters, depthMeters).

editVoxels({op, shape, resolutionMeters?, material?}, opts?) -> Promise<{ok, op, resolutionMeters, shape, cellsPlanned, cellsChanged, cellsUnchanged, chunksTouched, rejected:[{reason, cells}], before?, after?, stages:{...}}> — edit by coordinate, in any mode. op carve | fill | paint; resolutionMeters 0.1 | 1 | 10 (default 1); material paint | wall | roof | terrain. shape {cell:{center}} | {sphere:{center, radiusMeters}} | {capsule:{from, to, radiusMeters}} | {box:{center, sizeMeters:[x,y,z], frame:local|grid, yawDeg?}}; points are {lat, lon, elevMeters}. Edits only within about 200 m of the player. Resolves once the edit is solid; opts.persist:true also saves it. A change credits a quest Build step.
getEditBatchStats() -> {...} — edit batching counters.
getSurfaceIndexStats() -> {lookups, builds, entriesIndexed, appendsIndexed, verifyMisses} — voxel edit lookup index; verifyMisses should stay 0.
getSurfaceListLossStats() -> {..., anyLoss} — whether any voxel geometry was dropped for capacity this session.

getFeatureBudgetStats() -> {capFeatures, tilesHit, residentTilesHit, skippedTotal, tiles:[{tileKey, firstClass, emitted, skipped, skippedTotal}]} — z15 tiles whose OSM features exceeded the per-tile cap this session, and what was cut. skipped counts are upper bounds.
resetFeatureBudgetStats() -> true — clear the session record.

getChunkOverlapCapStats() -> {cap, chunksSaturated, droppedTotal, worstLoadedWanted, chunks:[{chunkKey, wanted, kept, dropped}]} — chunks whose OSM feature list exceeded the per-chunk cap this session, and how many features each dropped.
resetChunkOverlapCapStats() -> true — clear the session record.
measureShaderCompileMs(entryPoints?, runs=2) -> Promise<{entryPoint: number[]}> — cold compile time per worldgen compute pipeline, in ms; a unique source comment defeats the GPU program cache.
spawnNPC({distanceMeters?,type?,count?,spreadMeters?}) -> {ok, ids, reason?} — stand NPCs in front of the player. Character mode.
spawnNPCAt(positionWorld, up, direction, type?) -> {ok, id, reason?} — place an NPC at a world position. Prefer spawnNPCAtGeo.

spawnNPCAtGeo(lat, lon, {type?, tag?, name?, bearingDeg?, hostile?}) -> {ok, id, tag, hostile, talkable, elevMeters} — place an NPC at a location. A tag makes it talkable; hostile:true makes it an enemy that can be defeated. For a shopkeeper or quest giver use plantAnchor.
despawnNPC(id) / despawnAllNPCs() -> {ok, despawned?}

getNPCStats() -> {total, exists, pending, paused, slotsPerNPC, innerBodyContactsRejected, list:[{id,type,npcClass,dead,tag,exists,paused,health,groundState,position,speedH,speedV,sinkMeters,distanceToPlayerMeters}]} — all NPCs. health is a 0..1 fraction and only changes on hostiles.
spawnHostileNPC({count?,distanceMeters?,spreadMeters?,type?}) -> {ok, ids} — spawn enemies in front of the player.
killNPC(id) -> {ok, id, reason?} — defeat a hostile NPC. Refuses named (friendly) NPCs.
fireGun() -> {ok, queued} — fire the held gun along the current aim. Aim first (setAimScreenUV); confirm a hit with getLastGunHit().count after about 200 ms.
meleeStrike() -> {ok, queued} — punch. Reach is 1.6 m and there is a 400 ms cooldown; each hit takes 0.2 of a hostile's health. Confirm with getLastGunHit().count.
damageNPC(id, amount) -> {ok, id, health, killed, reason?} — take a 0..1 fraction of health off a hostile NPC.
getLastGunHit() -> {count, npcId, atMs, sinceMs, pointWorld, npcClass, npcTag, npcDead} | null — the last shot or punch that hit an NPC. Compare count before and after, not npcId.
getChunkHeapStats() -> {chunkCount, perChunkArraysMB, l2DedupIndicesMB, evictedL2MB, dedup:{...}} — chunk memory.
getNodeLodCompactionStats(reset?) -> {...} — render detail-level rebuild counters.
getCanonicalDedupStats(sampleSize?) -> {...} — voxel brick symmetry statistics (diagnostic).
getBoxExtentStats(sampleSize?) -> {...} — collision box statistics (diagnostic).
getBoundaryMergeComparison(sampleSize?) -> {...} — collision merge comparison (diagnostic).
getOctantCollapseStats(sampleSize?) -> {...} — voxel brick statistics (diagnostic).
getChunkGenBackpressureStats() -> {active, reason, ...} — whether world generation is throttled for memory.

getHeapAttribution() -> Promise<{mainHeap, cpuBufferMirrorsMB, stagingPoolMB, stagingPool, chunkHeap, gpu, workerWasm, knownExternalMB, residualMB, uaMemory:{totalMB, byType, byScope}}> — memory breakdown.
getShapeDedupStats() -> {available, innerShape, mergedBoxes, sharedCache:{...}, crossRealmDuplication:{...}} — collision shape cache.
stressUniqueBricks(chunkCount?, bricksPerChunk?, seed?) -> {ok, ...} — stress test: author unique voxel bricks nearby. Heavy; reload to recover.
stressChunkComplexity(x, y, z, opts?) -> {ok, ...} — stress test: fill one chunk at maximum complexity. Heavy, one chunk at a time; reload to recover.
stressAppendUniqueBricks(chunkCount?, bricksPerChunk?, seed?, doRender?) -> {ok, ...} — stress test: grow the voxel brick table toward capacity. Reload to recover.

probeChunkWedge(minMs?) -> [{key, step, stepName, dwellMs, tier, sentinel, inLod, brickCount, blockedBy, detail}] — chunks stuck longer than minMs (default 5000), longest first, with what each is waiting on.
getDemotionEvictionStats() -> {chunksFreed, mbFreed, mbbMarginSkipped, mbbRebuilds, mbbRebuildsQueued, marginRelapseRegens} — marginRelapseRegens should stay 0.
getWorkerLiveness() -> {available, workerHeartbeat, workerPhase(Label), pthreadHeartbeat, pthreadPhase(Label)} — physics thread heartbeats.
probePhysicsWedge(intervalMs?) -> Promise<{verdict, workerAdvanced, pthreadAdvanced, sample0, sample1}> — whether the physics threads are advancing.
placeVoxelL0()/placeVoxelL1()/removeVoxelL0()/removeVoxelL1()/placeVoxel()/removeVoxel()/paintVoxel() — deprecated; use editVoxels.
getLastToolEditOutcome() -> {op, resolutionMeters, applied, reason} | null — what the last edit-tool action did, with the reason if nothing changed.
setEquipment(name) — None | Projectile | Gun | Edit | Projector | Build | Melee | Deploy. Paint/Add/Remove/Worldgen select Edit with that operation.
setEditOperation(op) / getEditOperation() — the Edit tool operation: set | add | remove | worldgen.

setEditBrush({brush?, sizeMeters?, heightMeters?, orientation?, anchor?, snapDeg?, stroke?, level?}) / getEditBrush() — the Edit brush: cell | cube | sphere | cylinder | slab; sizeMeters 0.3..4; heightMeters 0.1..4; orientation gravity | horizontal | surface | grid; anchor surface | centre; snapDeg 0 | 15 | 45; stroke click | drag | line.
brushStroke(op, [{u, v}, ...], {settleFrames?}) -> Promise<{strokeState, last}> — a drag stroke through screen points; op fill | carve; needs stroke drag.
setEditAimDown(enable) — aim the held tool straight down below the player.

getInputOverrides() -> {latched, aimScreenUV, editAimDown, characterSteerTargetGeo, vehicleIntent, freeCameraIntent, helicopterIntent, planeIntent, heldKeys, heldMouseButtons, pointerLocked, mouseOnCanvas, interactAimTrustworthy} — every active agent input override. Check this first if aim, interact or movement stops responding.
clearInputOverrides() -> {cleared, before} — release every agent override and held key. Call before handing control back to a person.
setAimScreenUV(u, v | null) -> [u, v] | null — hold the aim on a screen point (also steers interact); null releases. Works in first person.
getAimScreenUV() -> [u, v] | null
setCameraMode(name) / getCameraMode() — FirstPerson | ThirdPerson on foot or in a vehicle; the FreeRoam variants in free camera.
aimCharacterAtGeo({lat, lon, elevMeters?}, opts?) -> Promise<{ok, residualDeg, iterations, ...}> — turn the character to aim at a point, so interact() hits it. Character mode.
getCharacterAim(target?) -> {headPitchDeg, totalErrorDeg, pitchErrorDeg, rangeMeters, withinReach} — current aim, optionally its error to a {lat, lon}.
setCharacterHeadPitch(deg) -> {ok, headPitchDeg} — set the on-foot look pitch.
setPaintSurfaceType(name) — paint | terrain | wall | roof: the material for paint and add edits.
setPaintColor(r,g,b) | setPaintColor("#rrggbb") -> {hex, rgb255, uniform} — set the paint colour for this page load.
getPaintColor() -> {hex, rgb255, uniform}
setEditScale(scale) — chunk (100 m, add only) | l0 (10 m) | l1 (1 m) | l2 (0.1 m).
getEditTarget() -> {hitMeters, normal, nodeIndex} | null — the surface the edit tool is aimed at, or null.
resolveEditTarget(forAdd?) -> {chunkKey, chunk:[x,y,z], l1:[x,y,z], l2, flatIndex, nodeIndex} | null — which voxel the next edit would change.

probeVoxel(cx,cy,cz, l1x,l1y,l1z) -> {found, voxel:{...}, osm:{osmRef, osmId, osmType, name, tags, wayTypeName, tileKey, buildingIndex} | null, l0:{...}, brickIndexInSurfaceList, surfaceVoxelCount, l2SolidBrickCount, saveNeeded} — decode one 1 m voxel and the OSM feature it came from (null for plain terrain).

osmFeatureAtScreen(u,v, opts?) -> Promise<{found, osmRef, osmId, osmType, name, tags, wayTypeName, tileKey, buildingIndex, hitDistanceMeters, reason}> — the OSM feature under a screen point. found:false comes with a reason.
getCollection() -> [{key, kind, title, sub, href, addedMs}] — the player's discovery collection, newest first. Saved across reloads; call clearCollection() before counting.
getEquipment() -> {name, equipment, operation, gun, slot} — what is held; slot -1 means no action-bar slot.

getGuns() -> {selected, held, firing, magazine, capacity, catalog:[{type, name, slot, magazineCapacity, damagePerHitFraction, ...}]}   /   setGun(type) -> {ok, gun, previous, refillQueued, held} — choose the gun type; also call setEquipment('Gun') to hold it. The magazine refills on the next frame.

getLastQuestItemImpact() -> {slot, itemKey, atMs, osmRef, osmId, name, wayTypeName, positionRelative, impactSpeedMps, matched, questId, stepIndex, targetOsmId, targetName} | null — where the last thrown quest item landed and whether it hit a quest target. Poll for it; null can mean not resolved yet.

getThrowableState() -> {key, name, carried, inWorld, inWorldOfKey, freeSlots, throwables, poolSize, canThrow}   /   setThrowable(key) -> {ok, key, carried} — choose which item a throw uses; also call setEquipment('Projectile').
getSkills() -> [{key, name, sub, icon, grantedMs}] / hasSkill(key) / grantSkill(key|spec) -> {ok, granted, skills} / revokeSkill(key) -> {ok, skills} — the player's skills.
getActionBar() -> {slotCount, selected, domSelected, slots:[{index, type, key, label, equipped}]} — the action bar; selected and domSelected should agree.
pressActionBarSlot(i) -> {ok, equipment, bar} — press an action-bar slot. An empty slot puts the tool away; pressing a held food slot eats it.

getConsumeState() -> {held, heldCount, channel:{key, elapsedMs, durationMs, fraction}|null, notice:{textKey, remainingMs}|null, returnEquipment, msSinceDamage} — eating or drinking in progress. Moving, damage or switching tools cancels it with a refund.
dropCash({cents?, distanceMeters?}) -> {ok, slot, cents} — drop cash in front of the character (default $20); picking it up adds to the wallet.
startConsume(key) -> {ok, queued} — start eating or drinking an item; not allowed during combat or within 3 s of damage.
setActionBarSlot(i, type, key) / moveActionBarSlot(from, to) -> {ok, bar} — assign or move an action-bar slot; type item | skill. Overwrites the target slot.

getWallet() -> {cents, text} — the player's money. addMoney(cents) / spendMoney(cents) -> {ok, cents, text} / setMoney(cents). Amounts are cents (100 = $1). Saved across reloads; set it before asserting a balance.

getInventory() -> [{key, name, sub, kind, icon, qty, addedMs}] — carried items, stacked by key. giveItem({key,name,sub,icon,kind,qty}) / takeItem(key, qty) -> {ok, qty, items} / hasItem(key, qty) / clearInventory(). Not saved across reloads.

getHoveredFeature() -> {osmRef, osmId, osmType, name, tags, wayTypeName, tileKey, buildingIndex, material, distanceMeters, pointRelative, interactable, questObjective, newDiscoveries, label} | null — the feature under the reticle that E would act on. Check interactable. Character mode, within about 10 m.
getGroundFeature(opts?) -> {contactPoints, feature} — the OSM feature the player is standing or driving on; null feature means not known yet.
getFootstepSurface() -> {ok, surface, voxel} — the surface under the player's feet: default | soft | paved | hollow | water.
getSurfaceGrip() -> {table, live[], surfaces[]} — tyre grip per surface, and the surface under each wheel.
setSurfaceGrip(name, mu) -> {ok, table} — set the tyre grip for one surface.
getTireSlipAudio() -> {surface, matchedRow, row, slip, wheelsOnGround, audible, wheelSurfaces[], table} — the tyre-slip sound state.
waitForEditTarget(timeoutMs?) -> Promise — resolves when the edit tool is aimed at a surface.
voxelEdit(op, opts?) -> Promise<{op, edited, target?, reason?}> — make one edit below the player; sets up the tool and restores it.
rapidVoxelEdit(op, count?, intervalMs?, opts?) -> Promise<{op, fired, withTarget}> — repeat an edit quickly (stress test).
voxelEditAtScreen(op, u, v, opts?) -> Promise<{op, edited, applied, voxel, before, after, target?, screen, reason?}> — edit at a screen point. Check applied, not edited.
diagnoseBuilding(opts?) -> Promise<{query, terrainElevMeters, buildings:[...]}> — building heights against the terrain at a point (diagnostic).
probePMTilesHosting(url?) -> Promise<{url, allPassed, checks:[{check,ok,detail}], header, totalSize}> — check an OSM map archive is reachable.
fetchOSMTile(z, x, y, opts?) -> Promise<{found, tileId, mvtBytes, layers, osm:{...}}> — fetch and summarize one OSM map tile.
geoToTile(lat, lon, z=15) -> {z, tileX, tileY, u, v, localX, localY, extent, tileMeters} — map tile and in-tile coordinates for a point.
osmRouteOf(props) -> {bucket, voxelizes} — how a set of OSM tags is classified and whether it becomes voxels.

osmDecodeTile(z, x, y, opts?) -> Promise<{found, tile, extent, featureCount, matched, features:[{id, type, typeName, tags, route, ringLens, vertexCount, bbox, geometry?}]}> — every feature in one map tile; opts {id, tag, includeGeometry}.
osmFeaturesAt(lat, lon, opts?) -> Promise<{tile, local, containing, near}> — the OSM features containing or near a point (opts.nearMeters, default 8).
osmSnapDoors(z, x, y) -> {tile, doorCount, buildingCount, snappedCount, unsnappedCount, snapped:[...]} — mapped entrances matched to building walls in a loaded tile.

worldgenDigest() -> {l1, words, nodes, chunksFolded, badMat, l2, l2FlatOnly, entries, boxes, chunksReady, branchPopulation} — a fingerprint of the generated world, for before/after comparison. badMat must be 0.

waitForWorldgenQuiescence({timeoutMs?, stableTicks?, pollMs?}) -> Promise<{settled, chunksReady, entries, chunkMapSize, elapsedMs, ticks}> — wait for world generation to settle before taking a digest.
compareWorldgenDigest(baseline) -> {identical, diff:{field:[was, now]}, got} — compare against an earlier digest. Compare like with like (cold load to cold load).
osmDoorFallbackStats() -> {picks, fronted, movedOffLongest, noRoadIndex, noWayInRange, tooFewWalls, frontedPct, movedPct} — how generated doors were placed.
osmSeaAreaLandStats() -> {tested, dropped, kept, noDem, timedOut, droppedIds, last} — sea-area polygons dropped as land.
osmPartsTiledStats() -> {outlines, capped, last:{...}} — buildings whose height was taken from their parts.
osmMouthSpanStats() -> {outlines, split, nodesAdded, splitPct, nodesPerSplit} — building outline splitting counters.
getDeviceTuning() -> {profile, deviceClass, tier, forced, signals:{...}, renderScaleDefault, chunkCount1d, tileLodCount1d, ...} | null — the device profile in use.
getCameraPose() -> {lat, lon, elevMeters, bearingDeg, pitchDeg, controlMode} | null — the free camera's position and orientation.
moveFreeCameraTo({lat, lon, elevMeters?, bearingDeg?, pitchDeg?}) -> {ok, pose} | {ok:false, reason} — move the free camera without a reload; follow with waitForChunksReady().
setCameraPitch(pitchDeg) -> {ok, pose} | {ok:false, reason} — set free-camera pitch (0 level, -90 straight down); in a vehicle or aircraft, same as aimCraftCamera({pitchDeg}).
setCameraBearing(bearingDeg, pitchDeg=0) -> {ok, pose} | getCraftLook() — set the free camera's bearing and pitch; in a vehicle or aircraft, same as aimCraftCamera.

getCraftLook() -> {ok, craft, cameraMode, yawDeg, pitchDeg, base:{bearingDeg, pitchDeg}, camera:{bearingDeg, pitchDeg}} | {ok:false, reason} — the vehicle or aircraft camera's look offsets, the direction it looks from, and where it looks now.
setCraftLook({yawDeg?, pitchDeg?}) -> getCraftLook() — set the vehicle or aircraft camera's look offsets, as mouse-look does; yaw > 0 turns left, pitch clamps to ±80. Takes effect next frame.

aimCraftCamera({bearingDeg?, pitchDeg?}) -> getCraftLook() — point the vehicle or aircraft camera at an absolute bearing and pitch. A 'Follow movement' camera eases there and recentres when you drive without looking.

getTurretAim() -> {exists, active, gunType, yawDeg, elevDeg, minPitchDeg, minPitchRearDeg, maxPitchDeg} — the turret barrel relative to the chassis; yawDeg > 0 is left, 180 is straight back. The turret aims at the reticle target: without pointer lock call setAimScreenUV(0.5, 0.5) so that is screen centre.
lookAtGeo({lat, lon, elevMeters?}) -> {ok, pose, rangeMeters} | {ok:false, reason} — point the free camera at a location.

viewBuildingFaces(lat, lon, opts?) -> Promise<{ok, id, tags, centroid, heightMeters, wallCount, faces:[{lengthMeters, bearingDeg, pose}], topDown}> — camera poses facing each wall of a building, plus a top-down pose.
tileToGeo(z, tileX, tileY, localX, localY, extent=4096) -> {lat, lon} — inverse of geoToTile.

osmWayPolyline(opts) -> Promise<{found, selector, wayCount, points:[{lat,lon}], pointCount, lengthMeters, closed, closureMeters, ringCount, tilesVisited, tilesWithFeature, segmentCount, bbox, note}> — an OSM road or path as one ordered list of points. Requires a selector (opts.id for one way, or opts.tag such as {key:'name', value:'King Street'}) and a starting point (opts.lat/lon or opts.tileX/tileY).
loopLaps(points, laps) -> points — repeat a closed route for several laps.

setFreeCameraIntent({forward, strafe, up, speedMps} | null) -> {forward,strafe,up,speedMps} | {cleared:true} | {ok:false, reason} — move the free camera at an exact speed; axes -1..1, strafe > 0 is left; null hands back control.
getLodGridProgress() -> {total, pending, ready, marginExcluded, readyFraction, deepestPendingStep} — world-build progress around the player; safe to poll.
getFlyThrottleState(mode?) -> {mode, gate, readyFraction, chunks, saves, underPressure} — what flyRoute is waiting on (mode chunks | saves | none).

flyRoute(opts) -> Promise<{ok, started, pointCount, lengthMeters, speedMps, throttle, aglMeters, lookAheadMeters, laps}> — fly the free camera smoothly along a route, slowing when the world is still building. opts {points | id+seed | tag+seed | bearingDeg+lengthMeters, speedMps=40, aglMeters, pitchDeg, lookAheadMeters, throttle=chunks|saves|none, minSpeedMps, turnRateDegPerSec, climbRateMps, arriveMeters, loop, laps, maxSeconds}; progress on window.__flyRoute.
stopFlyRoute() -> {stopped, at} — stop flyRoute and hand back the camera.

followRoute(opts) -> Promise<{ok, started, sampleCount, lengthMeters, stepMeters, speedMps, throttle, laps}> — step the free camera along a route, waiting for the world to build; opts {points | id+seed | tag+seed, speedMps=12, stepMeters, eyeMeters=6, pitchDeg=-8, throttle=true, loop, laps}; progress on window.__routeFollow.
stopRouteFollow() -> {stopped, at} — stop followRoute.

driveVehicleRoute(points, opts?) -> Promise<{ok, completed, reason, laps, lapsDone, lapTimes, distanceCoveredMeters, meanSpeedMps, maxSpeedMps, maxCrossTrackMeters, meanAbsHeadingErrDeg, stuckEvents, everPaused, workerErrorsDelta, vehicleType, dynamics:{...}}> — drive the vehicle along a list of points (at least 2), with telemetry. opts {laps=1, lookAheadMeters=14, speedMps=8, steerFullDeg=25, cornerSlowdown=true, arriveMeters=8, offRouteMeters=45, timeoutMs=180000}; progress on window.__vehicleRoute.
getVehiclePose() -> {pos:{lat,lon}, headingDeg} | null — the vehicle body's position and heading.
stopVehicleRoute() -> {stopped, at} — stop driveVehicleRoute.

getVehicleWheelProbe(reset?) -> Promise<{ok, steps, wheels:[{index, radius, contactFraction, hardPointFraction, steepNormalFraction, minNormalFwd, maxAbsNormalFwd, meanAbsNormalFwd, meanSuspensionLength}]}> — wheel contact statistics since the last reset (call with true to reset).
getVehicleDynamics() -> {exists, type, speedMps, leanDeg, wheelSlip, wheelsOnGround, engineRPM, pitchDeg} — current handling state; leanDeg is roll, positive left.
setVehicleType(id) -> {ok, requested, active} — choose the vehicle type; a live vehicle is rebuilt in place. Check active === requested.
getVehicleTypes() -> [id]   /   getVehicleSpec(id?) -> spec — vehicle catalog ids and a copy of a spec.

auditParkedVehicleRest(settleMs?) -> Promise<{ok, specId, declaredMeters, measuredMeters, deltaMeters, parkedHeightErrorMeters, perWheelMeters, spreadMeters, contactFractions}> — compare the vehicle's resting suspension to its spec. Run stationary on flat ground.
setVehicleIntentAnalog({throttle, steer, handBrake} | null) -> intent — smooth vehicle controls, -1..1 (throttle < 0 brakes); null hands back control.
setSurfacePaintBlend(mul) / getSurfacePaintBlend() -> number — strength of map colouring on roads and paths (0 = photo only, 1 = default).
setVoxelImageryQuantize(0|1|2) / getVoxelImageryQuantize() -> number — how voxels sample the satellite photo: 0 per pixel, 1 per 1 m cell, 2 per 0.1 m cell (default).

getInputHint(controlKey, categoryKey?) -> {device, input, action, fellBack} | null — how to perform a control on the current device ("press E", "tap the lower-left pad"). Changes with device, mode and pointer lock; do not cache.
getInputGroupHint([controlKey], categoryKey?) -> same shape — one hint for several controls that share a device input (WASD, the left stick).

getHintDevice() -> "keyboard"|"gamepad"|"touch"   /   auditInputHints() -> {device, pointerLocked, gaps[{category, control, boundOn, input}]} — the device hints are written for, and controls with no binding on it.

getQuestState() -> {activeQuestId, activeTemplateId, activeStepIndex, stepCount, stepText, stepShort, stepVerb, target, skippedSteps, trackedQuestId, discoveryTracked, trackingPinned, active[], completed[], lastCompletion, recentCompletions[], queueDepth} — quest progress. stepShort is the step as a short action ("Deliver letter to Mills House"), as the objective marker shows it. completed[] is ids only; results (splits, race time, reward) are in recentCompletions, newest first. active[].id is an instance id; compare templateId.
getQuestCatalog() -> [{id, name, scope, runtime, steps, applicableSteps}] — quest templates. runtime:true came from defineQuest and is gone after a reload.

defineQuest({id, name?, scope?, reward?:{cents}, steps:[{verb, selector?, text?, short?, area?, at?, spawnParked?, arrivalMeters?, pin?, grants?, consumes?, physicalDeliveryOnly?, npcOnly?, applicable?}]}) -> {ok, id, name, scope, steps, warnings?} | {ok:false, reason} — register a quest for this session, then startQuest(id). Verbs: moved, looked, reached, drivenTo, taken, interacted, edited, occupied, defeated, pointerLocked, firstPerson. Selectors: none, atGeo (at:{lat, lon, radiusMeters, name?}; radius required), osmArea (area:{bucket?, tag?, value?, id?}), spawnedVehicle (spawnParked:{specId}), nearestVehicle, nearestErrand, nearestPOI, questGiver, anyEdit, tutorialGuide. reached and drivenTo need a selector that names a place. Unknown fields are refused with the list of known ones. {target} in text is replaced with the target's name. Not saved across reloads.

makeScenarioLink(questSpec|null, {pose?, base?, preload?}) -> {ok, url, chars, questId, warnings?} | {ok:false, reason} — build a link that opens the site at pose ({lat, lon, bear?, ctrl?, elev?, pitch?}, default here) and starts the quest once the player spawns. The spec is checked as defineQuest would check it. The format can be written without this function: <site>/?lat=..&lon=..&bear=..&ctrl=1#scenario=<encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({v:1, quest:<spec>, preload?:{radiusMeters, lat?, lon?}}))>, or #scenario=b64.<base64url of the same JSON>. scope must be "once"; reward at most 10000 cents. preload (radiusMeters up to 1500, centre within 5 km of the spawn, default the spawn) generates and saves that area after spawn and before the quest starts; the player can cancel it. With preload, quest may be omitted.
readScenarioLink(url) -> {present, ok, quest?, reason?} — decode a link's scenario without starting it.

getScenarioLinkState() -> {present, decoded, applied, ok, reason, questId, appliedAtMs, preload, preloadSummary} — what happened to the scenario link this page was opened with (applied:false while waiting for spawn or for its preload; preload is null | pending | running | done | incomplete | cancelled | refused; a refusal is also shown on screen).

defineRace({id, name?, waypoints:[{lat, lon, name?}], closed?, laps?, radiusMeters?, startRadiusMeters?, finishRadiusMeters?}) -> {ok, id, gates, laps, closed, gatesPerLap, ...} | {ok:false, reason} — a race: drive to the start, through each gate in order, then the finish. Gates only count in a vehicle.

defineRace closed loops: closed:true makes waypoints[0] the start/finish line; laps:N runs it N times (laps > 1 needs closed:true and at least one gate besides the line). A repeated last point is dropped.
getQuestState().active[].{lap, laps, lapsMs} — current lap and lap times on a multi-lap race; null otherwise.

getRaceCourses() -> [{wayId, name, anchorId, lengthMeters, straightMeters, pointCount, pieces, joined, reversals, start, giver, car}] — race circuits found on the map (highway=raceway), each with a marshal who starts a race and a car beside them. A course appears once all of it is loaded.

getQuestState().lastCompletion -> {id, name, gates, splitsMs[], totalMs, raceMs, lapsMs[], skippedSteps, completedAtMs, rewardCents} | null — the most recent result. For a race use raceMs (start line to finish); totalMs includes time before the start.
isQuestAvailable(id, giverTag?) -> bool — whether a quest would be offered now.
startQuest(id, giverTag?) -> instanceId | false — start a quest. giverTag (the giver's anchor id) is required for a perGiver quest.
trackQuest(id|null) -> bool — choose which quest the objective marker follows; null shows discoveries instead.
abandonQuest(id?) -> bool — abandon a quest (default: the tracked one), taking back its items and any vehicle it parked. Pays nothing.
getBountyOffer() -> {questId, name, compass, distanceMeters, rewardCents} | null — the bounty job on offer.
getBountyTarget() -> {tag, lat, lon, name, npcId, exists, dead} | null — the running bounty's target. npcId stays null until the target has ground to stand on.
Bounty completion: defeat the target (shoot or punch it). killNPC(getBountyTarget().npcId) is a shortcut.
getQuestRandomSeed() -> number — the seed for courier job choices; reload with ?questseed=<seed> to repeat them.
skipQuestStep(id?) -> bool — advance a quest by one step without doing it.
resetQuestProgress() -> Promise<{cleared:[keys]}> — clear quest completions and restart the tutorial.
emitObjectiveEvent(type, id, detail?) — inject a quest event, for testing.
playCue(name) -> {ok, name, audioState} — play a sound cue: collect | accepted | step | complete. Silent until the page has had a user gesture.
getWorkerErrors() -> [{when, source, message, filename?, lineno?, colno?, stack?, payload?}] — physics worker errors, newest first.
clearWorkerErrors()
getLastWorkerError() -> {when, source, message, ...} | null
injectWorkerError(kind?, message?) — kind sync | promise; for testing error capture.
agentApiVersion: number

probeAhead({distanceMeters?=4, yawOffsetDeg?, tags?}) -> Promise<{ok, blocked, distanceMeters, feature}> — look ahead from the character's head and name what is there. Positive yawOffsetDeg looks right. Treat feature:null as unknown and probe again a frame later.

getDoorForPoint(lat, lon) -> {found, outdoors?, buildingIndex, source:"mapped"|"fallback", geo} — the main entrance of the building at a point. found:false with outdoors:true means the point is outside any building.

getBuildingDoors(lat, lon) -> {found, doors:[{source, edgeIndex, t, geo, distMeters, wallLengthMeters, alongWallMeters?}], nearest, counts, isLarge, bboxLongerMeters, perimeterMeters, eligibleWalls, procedural} — every entrance of the building at a point, nearest first. source mapped | frontage | back | spaced; confirm spaced ones with verifyBuildingDoors.
getNearestDoor(lat, lon, opts?) -> door | null — the closest entrance (opts.searchMeters also searches nearby buildings).

verifyBuildingDoors(lat, lon, opts?) -> Promise<{ok, predicted, probed, confirmed, missing, counts, rows}> — check each predicted entrance against the built world. The building must be within about 200 m of the player.
walkCharacterToPlace(target, opts?) -> Promise<{reached, reason, legs}> — walk to a point, going through a door first if it is inside a building.
getSurvival() / setSurvival({health?, hunger?, hydration?}) -> {health, hunger, hydration} — survival meters, 0..1. setSurvivalDrain({hunger, hydration}) sets drain per second.
setPlayerHealth(fraction) / getPlayerHealth() -> {health} — player health, 0..1.
agentApiList() -> string[] — this list.
api.list(filter?) -> [{name, signature, documented}] — every function on window.debug, sorted by name; filter is a substring or RegExp.
